device_entry.name: 串口通信组件
tags: 实验室自动化与仪器集成
实验仪器通信与驱动集成
device_entry.description: 这是一个非物理的软件通信组件，用于封装串口连接的启动、停止、缓冲区清理，以及按字节、字符串或整行进行读写。它主要用于实验系统与外部仪器、控制器或微控制器之间的串行数据交换，并提供异常处理以及字节与字符串之间的编码/解码支持。
device_entry.description_en: This is a non-physical software communication component that wraps serial port connection start/stop, buffer clearing, and byte-, string-, or line-based read/write operations. It is used to exchange serial data between a lab system and external instruments, controllers, or microcontrollers, while providing exception handling and byte/string encoding-decoding support.

schema.description: 查询当前串口接收缓冲区中的可读字符数量。
schema.description_en: Query the number of readable characters currently buffered in the serial receive buffer.

schema.description: 按指定字节数从串口读取原始字节数据。
schema.description_en: Read raw byte data from the serial port by the requested byte count.

schema.description: 按指定长度从串口读取并解码为字符串。
schema.description_en: Read data from the serial port by the requested length and decode it as text.

schema.description: 从串口读取一整行文本，直到行结束符。
schema.description_en: Read a full line of text from the serial port until the end-of-line marker.

schema.description: 向串口写入原始字节数据。
schema.description_en: Write raw byte data to the serial port.

schema.description: 向串口写入字符串数据。
schema.description_en: Write string data to the serial port.

schema.description: 向串口写入一行文本数据。
schema.description_en: Write a line of text data to the serial port.
